name: quiz-tools
description: Skills for the quiz app: author a quiz-set JSON (quiz-create) and upload it (quiz-upload).

gmail_oauth_path.title: Gmail OAuth client JSON
gmail_oauth_path.description: Absolute path to the Google OAuth client keys (gcp-oauth.keys.json) used by the Gmail MCP that the upload flow reads its login code from.

gmail_credentials_path.title: Gmail token store
gmail_credentials_path.description: Absolute path where the Gmail MCP keeps its authorised token (credentials.json). The file is created on first authorisation, so it need not exist yet.

gmail_account_name.title: Gmail account label
gmail_account_name.description: Short label for the mailbox the login code arrives in.
